description: Extract plain text + headings from Google Docs by ID via a service account. Works with an explicit list of doc_ids OR upstream of google_drive_ingestion (filter Drive to application/vnd.google-apps.document, feed IDs here).

outputs.description: One row per Doc with id, title, word_count, plus optional `text` and `headings` columns.

credentials_path.label: Credentials Path
credentials_path.description: Path to service-account JSON. Falls back to GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.

doc_ids.label: Doc IDs
doc_ids.description: Explicit list of Google Doc IDs. Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream DataFrame asset. Each row's id_column value is treated as a Doc ID.

id_column.label: ID Column
id_column.description: Column with the Doc IDs in the upstream DataFrame.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a markdown preview of the fetched rows in the materialization metadata.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Max rows to include in the preview when include_preview_metadata is True.

name: Google Docs Extractor
